name: 弹簧跳兔
brief: Lean long-eared hare with oversized living hind feet, exposed spring braces alongside both hind legs, a small numbered steel collar, one naturally folded ear. Low horizontal body, alert forward ears, no gun. Former parcel courier; zigzag bounds.

name: 液压獠猪
brief: Heavy wild boar with bristled arching back, short thick legs and living tusks. A yellow hydraulic jaw yoke and twin shoulder pistons brace a bulldozer-like forehead plate. Former scrap compactor; plants feet then headbutts.

name: 铆钉豪猪
brief: Low waddling porcupine, natural face and tiny feet beneath a broad fan of long cream quills; several quills held in a rusty pneumatic nail-launch rack along the back, a small pressure cylinder on the side. Fires a fan of rivets.

name: 熔断穿山甲
brief: Pangolin with overlapping brown scales, long tapering plated tail, pointed inquisitive snout and tiny claws. A red cracked battery strapped into a gap in its back scales, exposed ceramic fuse at shoulder. Curls forward when overloading; biological animal first.

name: 号令蝉
brief: Large squat cicada with amber translucent folded veined wings, bulky organic thorax, six short gripping feet and bulging red eyes. A salvaged brass loudspeaker replaces one dorsal shell plate, antenna wires clipped to natural feelers. A communications species calling the riot swarm.

name: 孵箱负鼠
brief: Long pale-faced opossum with black eyes, rounded pink ears, grasping paws and long bare curling tail. A small open steel nursery cage rides on its back with two tiny biological joeys peering out, straps follow torso. Former laboratory carrier; releases offspring.

name: 拆城巨猿
brief: Massive silverback gorilla, low heavy knuckle stance and intelligent angry face. One enlarged demolition-clamp prosthetic forearm with hydraulic hoses, opposing natural hand, salvaged crane-counterweight harness on broad shoulders. Asymmetric recognizable ape silhouette, no crown. Former demolition labor animal turned riot leader.

name: 拖油蛞蝓
brief: Long green-brown slug with muscular rippling foot, four eye feelers and raised mantle. A bolted leaking oil-filter housing seated in its mantle, a hose trailing along one side. Organic asymmetrical crawling silhouette; former pipe-cleaner now leaves oily poison trail.

name: 闸钳泥蟹
brief: Broad mud crab with eight splayed walking legs, eye stalks and unequal claws. One giant claw reinforced with an industrial sluice-gate clamp and exposed blue-gray screw gear; smaller opposite claw remains biological. Broad sideways silhouette, wet olive shell, rust joints.

name: 压泵蟾蜍
brief: Very squat mottled toad with swollen throat pouch, blunt head, golden eyes and folded haunches. A pressure gauge and brass pump valve grafted into its throat brace, paired delivery tubes along cheeks. Inflates throat and spits chemical blobs. Clear living toad, not a mechanical sphere.

name: 浮囊河豚
brief: Mutant floating pufferfish with spiny pear-shaped body, expressive small puckered mouth, small fins and tapered tail. A dented compressed-gas saddle tank fixed along upper back, breathing tubes into gills, rusted pressure relief valve. Organic spines, off-center bulging cheeks, no propeller.

name: 输液长蚊
brief: Long delicate mosquito with six thin jointed hanging legs, narrow thorax, two transparent blade-shaped wings and a heavy red segmented abdomen. A glass collection vial and thin surgical-steel proboscis brace attached to the natural feeding tube. Medical extraction insect turned blood thief.

name: 育槽蝾螈
brief: Long orange-brown salamander with four splayed toes, flattened paddle tail and external feathery gills. A transparent incubator trough with three small eggs strapped low across its back and two flexible aeration hoses, old laboratory tag. Belly close to ground, distinct amphibian anatomy.

name: 清淤章鱼母机
brief: Giant land-crawling octopus with eight thick distinct curling arms and a tall mottled purple mantle, intelligent slit eyes. A round iron dredging-pump crown clamped to mantle, two arms fitted with suction nozzles, visible big intake wheel on one flank. Several arms planted carrying weight; NOT a round blob with random tentacles.

name: 线圈蜻蜓
brief: Slender dragonfly with long segmented abdomen, four long narrow translucent wings in two attached pairs and large teal eyes. A copper induction coil wrapped around thorax with a small ceramic insulator on tail. Former line-inspection insect, fast darting attack; recognizable dragonfly proportions.

name: 叉举锹甲
brief: Stocky stag beetle with glossy dark wing cases, six hooked jointed legs and huge curved mandibles. Both mandibles reinforced with yellow forklift tines and a compact lift piston between them; shell mostly living cuticle. Low armored pushing stance.

name: 焊枪螳螂
brief: Tall praying mantis with triangular head, long thin neck, folded serrated forearms and four long supporting legs. One forearm carries a compact MIG welding nozzle and a hose to a waist-mounted wire spool; other arm natural and hooked. Stands in alert three-quarter posture, industrial teal armor fragments.

name: 断路蜗牛
brief: Large cream snail with long eye stalks and a heavy spiral shell. The outer shell spiral has a bolted circular capacitor bank and copper bus bars following its natural curve, a cracked red warning lamp near shell lip. Slow crawling animal, unstable stored charge; distinct from slug.

name: 缝补蜘蛛
brief: Compact jumping spider with eight jointed legs, forward large glossy eyes and two furry pedipalps. A white industrial thread spool on the abdomen and two tiny soldering tips strapped along front feet. Curious organic spider face, patched cream service harness. Repairs other escaped species.

name: 铸巢白蚁后
brief: Termite queen with small angular head and thorax, six short legs, an enormous elongated segmented cream abdomen carried by a low wheeled nursery brace. A tiny brass extrusion nozzle behind abdomen and hatch ribs along brace. Living segmented animal with support machinery, no generic robot torso.

name: 反应炉铁背象
brief: Enormous battle-scarred elephant with unmistakable trunk, broad ears, thick four legs and ivory tusks. A squat industrial furnace and copper coolant pipes bolted to shoulder saddle, reinforced steel shoes, one tusk fitted with a grounded electrode sleeve. Former mobile foundry animal now in revolt. Heavy living elephant dominates silhouette.

name: 滑砂响尾蛇
brief: Long sidewinding rattlesnake with flattened triangular head, coherent S-shaped body and a raised segmented rattle. Small articulated steel skid plates along underside and a cable plugged into the rattle, sandy scales and dark dorsal diamonds. Former tunnel cable-puller; flank attacks.

name: 钻颅鼹鼠
brief: Stocky dark velvet mole with tiny eyes, pink nose and two huge broad outward-facing digging hands. A blunt auger drill crown over forehead and steel digging finger sleeves on one hand, shoulder coolant canister. Low broad burrowing silhouette, recognizably mammalian, not a drill robot.

name: 雷达秃鹫
brief: Tall hunched vulture with bare wrinkled red head, hooked beak, feather ruff, folded long black wings and strong bird feet. Small off-center radar dish over one shoulder and a long thin optical sight mounted along beak, one telescopic leg brace. Patient observant sniper silhouette.

name: 爆囊沙蝎
brief: Low ochre scorpion with two pincers, eight short walking legs and a high arched segmented tail. A red explosive ampoule replaces the terminal venom bulb, bound in a metal safety cage, thin fuse wire follows tail joints. Tail connects clearly to rear body, no detached stinger.

name: 风笛鬣蜥
brief: Long spiny-crested iguana with four splayed feet, hanging dewlap and tapering tail. Three mismatched organ pipes in a brass resonance pack along its back connected to throat by one tube; small cracked radio ear tag. Desert signal relay animal rallying nearby species, natural reptile anatomy.

name: 蜂箱双峰驼
brief: Lean two-humped Bactrian camel with long bent neck, small head, long jointed legs and shaggy underside. A low wooden-and-steel insect nursery fitted between its two humps, mesh vents and small bees visible at an open side hatch. Former mobile pollination carrier releases swarms.

name: 破阵犀王
brief: Huge rhinoceros with thick folded hide, four heavy planted feet, small ears and two horns. The front horn sleeved in a massive asymmetrical steel breaching wedge, layered salvage shields over one shoulder, towing chain and torn industrial ID banner along rump. Animal still dominates, no humanoid armor suit. Escaped armored security beast and riot leader.

name: 逃笼幼负鼠
brief: Small escaped offspring or carrier insect, with a tracking implant; summoned by its associated adult.
